notes.prism_defect_for_prism_lane: WideEngine Gray kTRC source with black_point_compensation=true: BpcReport.source_black_lstar is garbage (gamma 2.0 profile: -3613.19, scale 0.2; gamma 1.8: -1.5e11), output for gray 0.25 is 0.85 instead of 0.25; with BPC off results are correct. Cause: companion PCS value for gray input exactly 0.0 is not 0 (clip report on the same call shows overshoot 4.0 for 1 pixel, channels [1,1,1]). Repro: v2.1 mntr GRAY/XYZ profile, wtpt D50, kTRC curv count=1 gamma u8Fixed8 0x0200 (tests/common/icc.rs gray_profile(2.0)), destination sRGB-linear-v4, Relative colorimetric, BPC on, pixels [0,0.5,1]. Importer works around it by not sending BPC for gray (gray black is Y=0 so BPC is the identity against a matrix destination).
